digest.en: Kyiv accuses Russia of violating ceasefire with fresh strikes. Iran seeks a 'comprehensive agreement' with the U.S. amid escalating tensions. China lodges a protest in response to UK sanctions, adding another layer to the complex geopolitics.

articles.summary: Ukraine's Kyiv reported fresh Russian attacks despite a unilateral ceasefire. The attacks occurred amidst ongoing conflict between Ukraine and Russia. Ukraine war latest: Kyiv reports fresh Russian attacks despite unilateral ceasefire The Independent.

articles.summary: US President Trump announced a shift in focus on the Strait, pausing a day-old escort mission. The move came hours after Secretary of State Marco Rubio had affirmed the mission, which was created with little connection to the original war justification.

articles.title: Israeli attacks on southern, eastern Lebanon kill at least six people
articles.summary: Israeli attacks on southern and eastern Lebanon killed at least six people. Israel also issued forced displacement orders for 12 villages in southern Lebanon. Israel issues forced displacement orders for 12 villages in southern Lebanon.

articles.summary: A Mexico City nightclub, Japan, charges US citizens $300 for entry, while citizens of other countries pay $20 and Mexicans pay $14. The owner cited a year of insults from the US as the reason for the discriminatory pricing.

articles.title: China’s top envoy calls for a ‘comprehensive ceasefire’ in the Iran war

articles.title: Does Quarantine On A Cruise Ship Minimise Disease Spread?

articles.title: Pakistan Navy Helps Stranded Indian Ship In Arabian Sea After SOS Message

articles.summary: The US and Iran are reportedly close to finalizing a one-page memo to end the war, with key provisions including a moratorium on Iran's nuclear enrichment. The deal aims to bring an end to the conflict.

articles.title: "Killing Like We Haven't Killed Since 1967": Israeli Army Chief's Big Remark
